symbols.name: input vector
symbols.meaning: A vector of $q$ complex numbers, the input to the opposite transform.

symbols.name: second input vector
symbols.meaning: A second vector of $q$ complex numbers, paired with $u$ in a convolution.
symbols.quote: For a second vector $u'$ of $q$ complex numbers, let $u\ast u'$ be the cyclic convolution of $u$ and $u'$.

symbols.name: second input index
symbols.meaning: An index running from $0$ to $q-1$ that labels an entry $u'_t$ of the second vector.
symbols.quote: Write $t$ for the input index of $u'$, running from $0$ to $q-1$, so that $(u\ast u')_\ell=\sum_{s+t\equiv\ell \pmod q}u_s u'_t$ with $s$ and $t$ over $0,\dots,q-1$.

relations.quote: The opposite transform $F_q^+$ is the sign-reversed form of the [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md).

It maps products back from the [frequency domain](frequency-domain.md) to coefficients, which makes it the step that recovers convolution coefficients on the way to exact integer multiplication below $n\log n$.

relations.quote: It is applied to the result of a [pointwise product](pointwise-product.md) of forward transforms.

relations.predicate: is applied along the axes of
relations.quote: The opposite transform is applied along the axes of an [array](array.md), one axis at a time.
